summary: Howards Cove Light, first lit in 1960 above the harbour on PEI's western shore; the present tower stands, Coast Guard-owned, grounds open and tower closed.

light.note: Flash 2 s, eclipse 4 s (Coast Guard list; LighthouseFriends). Marked 'Seasonal' on the Coast Guard list.

structures.type: square pyramidal wood tower with lantern and gallery
structures.note: Built 1978 (Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society; Rowlett). LighthouseFriends says 1976.

staffing.note: Always electrified; no keepers (Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society).

facts.ownership: federal (Government of Canada); petition for transfer to the Howard's Cove Harbour Authority under the Heritage Lighthouse Program

events.note: Station established at Howard's Cove in 1960.
The Giant's Chair rock beside the site is noticed missing during harbour construction; it is later returned to the cliff top (1960 report, as quoted by LighthouseFriends).
Present tower dated 1978 (Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society; Rowlett). LighthouseFriends dates it 1976.
Cove port authority hopes to take ownership of the light under the Coast Guard divestiture program (2011 newspaper, as cited by LighthouseFriends).

corrections.why: 1960 is the year the station was first established; the present tower is dated 1978 by the Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society and by Rowlett (LighthouseFriends says 1976).
The Coast Guard list, LighthouseFriends and the Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society all give the tower height as 5.8 m (19 ft).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: LighthouseFriends gives 1976 for the present tower; the Prince Edward Island Lighthouse Society and Rowlett both give 1978. The story gives both years and says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: Thin station: the light dates from 1960 and no keepers were ever posted (always electrified). The corpus of Marine annual reports ends in 1923-24, so nothing from the official reports covers this light; the Canadian Coast Guard list (modified 2026-08-25) is the only current official source read. Tower date conflict: 1976 (LighthouseFriends) against 1978 (PEI LHS, Rowlett). Rowlett says 'Located on private property' while the same entry and LighthouseFriends give the Coast Guard as owner and site manager; the story follows the owner statements. The 'Seasonal' remark on the Coast Guard list is not explained in the list itself. The 1959-60 Giant's Chair account and the 2011 divestiture item are known only through LighthouseFriends' quotations of the Journal-Pioneer; the newspapers themselves were not read. No newspaper search was run for this station (the two searches for the other PEI range lights returned nothing relevant). Status of the Heritage Lighthouse Program petition after 2021 is not in any source read. Current owner per the 2021 PEI LHS page is the federal government. Checker pass (2026-10-28): the story was checked line by line against LighthouseFriends, the Coast Guard List of Lights entry 1032 (LFl W 6s, 14.2 m, 12 nautical miles, Seasonal), the PEI Lighthouse Society page (2021) and Rowlett. The Society's page is dated 2021, so its ownership and petition statements are attributed to that date; the word 'later' was removed because no source dates the petition. The story now has no headings, as the thin-evidence shape requires.
